title: Lamb and Zesty Chinese Stir Fry
description: A rich and flavorful stir fry dish made with lamb and a zesty Chinese sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, and ground cumin to the skillet.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return the lamb to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the lamb is cooked through.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
